# Illustrative cost table for the capture in testdata/capture.
#
# THESE NUMBERS ARE NOT MEASURED AND NOT DERIVED. They exist to exercise the
# table format and the census join, and they are wrong as a description of what
# these MLX kernels move. Nobody here has the operand shapes for this capture,
# and a capture does not record them, so no honest byte count can be written.
# A real table cites, per line, the tensor shapes and element format the number
# came from; see ds4-weight-bytes.txt for what that looks like.
#
# The residency column is "unknown" here for the same reason: nobody here knows
# whether this MLX run's operands were cudaMalloc'd or mapped, and the capture
# cannot say. "unknown" is the honest entry, and Points will refuse these rather
# than judge them against a ceiling that may be 1.43x wrong.
#
# symbol  residency  bytes-per-launch  [flops-per-launch]
